persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Put this bottle on a light stone kitchen counter, with a tidy modern kitchen behind it. Keep the bottle exactly as it is. Square photo, no text.
bank.Which product: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
bank.New background and style: A photorealistic tidy modern kitchen with a light stone counter; other details are your call.
bank.Product changes: Keep the bottle's shape, matte black finish and visible details unchanged.
bank.Size and text: One square image at the standard free size, with no added text.

messages.text: Could you take the bottle in this pic and put it on a light stone kitchen counter? I’ve been trying to picture it in a kitchen setting, and I’m a little worried it could end up looking out of place. I want a square photo, with no text. Please have a tidy modern kitchen behind it. Keep the bottle exactly as it is.
